mapper.select: SELECT r.id "id", r.classroom_id "classroomId", c.room_number "roomNumber", r.reservation_date "reservationDate", r.slot_start "slotStart", r.slot_end "slotEnd", r.status "status", r.purpose "purpose", u.nickname "applicant" FROM busi_reservation r JOIN busi_classroom c ON c.id = r.classroom_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status IN (0, 1) AND r.classroom_id = #{classroomId} ORDER BY r.reservation_date, c.room_number, r.slot_start

SELECT r.id "id", r.classroom_id "classroomId", c.room_number "roomNumber", r.reservation_date "reservationDate", r.slot_start "slotStart", r.slot_end "slotEnd", r.status "status", r.purpose "purpose", r.reject_reason "rejectReason", r.create_time "createTime" FROM busi_reservation r JOIN busi_classroom c ON c.id = r.classroom_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id "id", r.reservation_date "reservationDate", r.slot_start "slotStart", r.slot_end "slotEnd", r.purpose "purpose", u.nickname "applicant", c.room_number "roomNumber", c.capacity "capacity" FROM busi_reservation r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id JOIN busi_classroom c ON c.id = r.classroom_id WHERE r.status = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time ASC
